/**
 * The Banner's mesh glows (Figma renders one pair per layout and line count), inlined as WebP
 * data URIs so they work wherever the component goes: from npm, copied by the shadcn CLI, or in
 * Next.js, with no image files to serve. Each pair is a light glow (drawn in Multiply) and a dark
 * one (in Screen). Regenerate from the Figma PNGs at 2× and WebP quality 80.
 */
export type Mesh = { light: string; dark: string }

const webp = (base64: string) => `data:image/webp;base64,${base64}`

const horizontal_one_light = webp('')
const horizontal_one_dark = webp('')
const horizontal_two_light = webp('')
const horizontal_two_dark = webp('')
const sidebar_one_light = webp('')
const sidebar_one_dark = webp('')
const sidebar_two_light = webp('')
const sidebar_two_dark = webp('')

export const bannerMesh: Record<'horizontal' | 'sidebar', Record<'one' | 'two', Mesh>> = {
  horizontal: {
    one: { light: horizontal_one_light, dark: horizontal_one_dark },
    two: { light: horizontal_two_light, dark: horizontal_two_dark },
  },
  sidebar: {
    one: { light: sidebar_one_light, dark: sidebar_one_dark },
    two: { light: sidebar_two_light, dark: sidebar_two_dark },
  },
}
